note: Team notes for the pilot day, from the Zocus WhatsApp group. One entry per conversation, keyed by the conversation number (the # shown in the dashboard and in the refresh list). Any field can be left out. rep = showroom rep who handled it; customer = customer name; segment = customer type; model = car discussed; value = rupees, only when the team wants to set it by hand; drop = true to leave the call out of the dashboard; why = reason for dropping, shown as a count on the dashboard.
